subject: Request: Combined pilot credits + discount for Kestrel Labs (exec approval)
messages:
From: Arielle Torres <arielle@kestrellabs.com>
To: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel pilot - request for make-good + short extension

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for running the pilot with our team — the model latency and semantic search improvements are already visible in our QA runs. We finished the internal review this morning and have a couple of asks before we sign the onboarding contract: 1) a modest make-good in the form of additional free credits to cover the unplanned spike we saw in week two, and 2) a 30-day extension on the trial end date so our procurement can complete the PO.

Can Redwood do a combined concession (credits + a one-time 15% discount on first-quarter committed usage) to close this quickly? We have budget authority but need an approval path from our procurement and finance team.

Attached is a short usage summary and notes from our SRE team (see attachment: Kestrel_Pilot_Usage_Summary.xlsx). If we can get a finalized concession memo and a signed MSA/quote from you by the end of next week, we can expedite the PO.

Best,
Arielle
Head of Integrations, Kestrel Labs
[Attachment: Kestrel_Pilot_Usage_Summary.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Torres <arielle@kestrellabs.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kestrel pilot - request for make-good + short extension

Hi Arielle —

Really appreciate the detailed summary and the quick review on your side. Ben and I reviewed usage and we can support a pilot-topup credit to cover the spike. For the 15% discount on committed Q1 usage, I need executive OK because this combines a rate concession with credits. Ben, I'm looping you in to confirm numbers; can you prepare a short quote and a one-page concession memo we can route for approval?

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Ben: draft the Proposed_Sweetener_Quote.pdf and a concise concession justification
- I: route to Marissa for exec signoff if numbers meet our thresholds
- Arielle: share the procurement timeline and PO owner so we can include them on the DocuSign envelope

If it helps, we can also include a 30-day trial extension in the quote so procurement has a clean paper trail.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Signature]

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Sep 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Kestrel pilot - proposed sweetener and numbers

Irene/Marissa —

Draft quote and concession note attached. High level: 75k free tokens (make-good credit), 15% discount on committed spend for Q1 (valid for a 3-month commit), and a 30-day trial extension. Estimated impact to ARR in year 1 is modest (finance estimate attached) and we're classifying this as a strategic onramp for a potential 3-year expansion.

Attached: Proposed_Sweetener_Quote.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan.docx

Marissa — requesting exec approval. Key ask: sign off on combined concession (credits + discount) and sign the attached one-page concession memo. If you want, we can tighten the commit to a 6-month minimal floor to reduce downside.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Director, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Proposed_Sweetener_Quote.pdf (PDF)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Sep 2028 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Kestrel pilot - proposed sweetener and numbers

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the numbers and the commercial logic. Approve in principle under two conditions: 1) add a 6-month minimum commitment floor (we convert the Q1 discount into a pro-rated incentive if they commit 6 months), and 2) include a clause that the make-good credits are one-time, non-recurring and valid only if they sign within 21 days of quote issuance.

Markus — can finance sign off on the revised structure? If yes, I'll countersign the one-page concession memo and we can send DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kestrel pilot - finance clearance

Marissa, Ben —

Finance OK on the structure with Marissa's conditions. We ran a quick sensitivity on adoption scenarios; downside is acceptable with the 6-month floor and the 21-day signature window. Please add the pro-rata clause language and the make-good expiration to the concession memo. Once updated, route back to me and I'll add the finance approval stamp.

Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal_finance_note.txt (TXT)]

From: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Torres <arielle@kestrellabs.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Sep 2028 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Final concession memo and next steps (DocuSign link included)

Arielle —

Thanks for patience. Attached is the revised concession memo and the formal quote reflecting the approved changes: 75k one-time pilot credit, 15% Q1 discount converted to a pro-rated incentive tied to a 6-month minimum commitment, 30-day trial extension, and a 21-day signature window for the credit to be valid. Finance and Commercial Ops have signed off.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-kestrel-quote

Next steps for Kestrel:
- Review and sign the DocuSign envelope within 21 days to secure the make-good credits
- Procurement to route PO referencing DEAL-2028-KST-084
- We will provision credits and update your account immediately after signature, and apply the discount on first invoice post-commitment

Attachments: Proposed_Sweetener_Quote.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan.docx

Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan.docx (DOCX)]
